title: About Nazryx: market data and market entry for frontier markets
description: Nazryx connects medicine makers with the frontier markets that need them, and runs the trade in between. Teams in Lahore and on the ground in Almaty.

sections.title: Every tablet has a journey.
sections.lede: From the plant to the patient. Nazryx connects medicine makers with the frontier markets that need them, and runs the trade in between.

items.title: Intelligence
items.text: We know these markets line by line, from our own data, kept current.

items.title: Access
items.text: We open markets: registration, local representation and partners, all in the maker's name.

items.title: Trade
items.text: We keep products moving: sourcing, supply, promotion and state bids, run by our teams.

items.title: Both sides of the trade
items.text: We work with makers and buyers, so we see supply and demand at once.

items.title: Data no one else assembles
items.text: Our own market data, built market by market.

items.title: People on the ground
items.text: Teams in Lahore and Almaty, and local networks in every market we serve.

items.title: Aligned incentives
items.text: Our commission is tied to your sales. The market stays in the maker's name.

items.title: Manufacturers
items.text: Of finished medicines and devices, looking for new markets.

items.title: Suppliers and distributors
items.text: Looking for vetted products and data on demand.

items.title: Institutional buyers
items.text: State and hospital buyers looking for reliable, validated supply.

sections.title: Talk to us.
sections.text: Send your product list, or book twenty minutes.
